title: Q-WORKERS-242: OWNERLINK-1: every owner action is one point-and-click link (owner page, OAuth flows, preflight enforcement)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** issueloop and queue --run, daily
**Done check:** file:workers/core/ownerlink/ownerlink.test.js
**Status:** open

Moved from ultrastable/workers#242 (workers repo archived; code now under workers/ here, issues disabled on this repo).

Owner role: operations. Trigger: any gate card or access ask.

Problem: when something truly needs the owner, the owner must never copy values or follow steps. Standing rule (Rowan, 2026-11-17): one link, sign in, then OAuth/OIDC and callbacks do the rest, as with the GitHub App.

Done check:
- `core/ownerlink`: `/owner` page behind owner sign-in (GitHub App session or Cloudflare Access JWT) listing every open owner action, one button each.
- Flows: Mastodon (dynamic app registration, authorize, callback, token into the vault; signup link), Bluesky (atproto OAuth: PKCE, PAR, DPoP, callback, tokens into the vault), PR approvals (open PRs waiting on a human reviewer, one link each).
- Preflight hook: a database trigger refuses any access gate card without a link row; `askOwner` files the link with the card, or the ask is refused and a staff item is filed to build the flow.
- Tests: `core/ownerlink/ownerlink.test.js`.

Closing probe: `node --test core/ownerlink/ownerlink.test.js core/access/access.test.js`, then GET `/owner` on the live org returns the sign-in button without a session.

**Closing probe:** `file:workers/core/ownerlink/ownerlink.test.js`
